rules.behavior: The same musical composition, not title resemblance alone, is mandatory for admitting a Cover candidate.
acceptance: Cloud approval never grants work identity

rules.behavior: First 50 results must preserve the verified LAB45 search, display, ranked audio and UI behavior.
Cerca ancora appends up to 50 NEW recordings each round, keeping all prior rows frozen, order stable, no exact recording or video ID duplicates.
Cerca video re-resolves the same recording; Cambia cover selects a DIFFERENT rendition, with separate actions and fresh results.

Prefer official/released renditions in initial round, talent/live/semi-official in second, amateurs/instrumental in third, and targeted long-tail in later rounds; admit any valid missed sources in later rounds.
acceptance: Adaptive query families without title-only false positives
Category does not override verified work

rules.behavior: A Cloud record must retain and restore all AVAILABLE title, original-work, artist, image, verified playback, date, credits, score, category, round and position metadata; missing provider fields stay null, never fabricated.
acceptance: Additive D1 migration and read/write contract test
No false claim that stale image/video is playable

rules.behavior: Approval is not evidence score; preserve legacy integer 1..20 plus independently computed 0..100 MusicLab points without calling it statistically calibrated reliability.
acceptance: Equal /100 scores allowed with deterministic tie handling

rules.behavior: Discovery must remain bounded and not steal audio resources from actual playback; release jobs on exit and avoid redundant probes.
Cloud writes require authenticated and confirmed server pathway, staging isolation and separate production approval; Android Turbo current D1 shared writes remain blocked.
acceptance: No write in current shared read-only Turbo

rules.behavior: Verified rules remain durable in GitHub with ownership, tests, supersession; native app implements stable operational behavior without host chat.
